# Pack keys

Every key a pack may set, by file and by block. `*` stands for a name the pack chooses and `[]` for each item of a list. *Notes* says when a key is required, the values or range it takes, and `security` for a key the fence, the gate or the vault reads. *Default* is the value in force when the pack leaves the key out; a blank cell means there is none (the feature is off, or the key is required). `cockpit pack explain <key>` prints the same for one key of the bound pack, with the value in force.

In any string value of these files `{home}` is the reader's home folder and `{local.<name>}` is the value the optional `pack.local.yaml` beside `pack.yaml` gives that name; they are tokens of every file, not keys, and [customize/personal-values.md](../customize/personal-values.md) is their recipe.

## pack.yaml

### Single keys

| Key | Type | Notes | Default | What it does | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | str | required |  | The pack's name, which `pack check` prints and the pages show. | `example` |
| `board` | str | required |  | The Hermes kanban board every card of this pack lives on. | `example` |
| `ticket_pattern` | regex | security | `"^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]*(?:-[A-Z0-9]+)+$"` (also when empty or 0) | The shape of a ticket key, never looser than the kernel's own. | `^TASK-[0-9]+$` |
| `branch_prefix` | str |  | `"work"` (also when empty or 0) | The first part of a ticket's branch: <branch_prefix>/<ticket>. | `work` |
| `commit_trailer` | str |  |  | A text the pack keeps for its own commit messages; no kernel code reads it. | `[{ticket}]` |
| `base_branch` | str |  | `"main"` (also when empty or 0) | The branch a repo's work starts from and its PRs target when the repo names no base. | `main` |
| `workspace_branch` | str | security | `""` (also when empty or 0) | The workspace repo's own branch, which only the human writes and the records are committed on. | `main` |
| `human_browser_port` | int | security |  | The debugging port of the human's own browser, which a lane reaches only on loan. | `9222` |
| `shared_chrome_hours` | int | security | `0` (also when empty) | How many hours a loan of the human's browser lasts; the Settings page overlays it. | `4` |
| `skills_dir` | list | required |  | The folders the pack's skills are found in, each absolute or {pack}/<folder> for one inside the pack (a fixture pack may name @<folder>). | `["/srv/example/skills"]` |
| `slot_provider` | str |  | `"pack"`; `"none"` when `seats.slots` is `0` | What runs a slot's stack: none, pack (the pack's slots block) or a provider's name. | `none` |
| `finding_labels` | list |  | `[]` (for anything but a list with items) | The tags that mark a review comment as a finding (`B:`, `Q:`), which is how a comment asks for work; with none, as with a value that is no list, only a suggestion block asks for work. | `["B", "Q"]` |
| `working_days` | list |  | `[]` (also when the key has no value) | The days of the week work happens on, Monday 0 to Sunday 6: the crons and the standup window follow them. | `[0, 1, 2, 3, 4]` |
| `scratch` | path | security | `""` (also when empty or 0) | A folder outside the workspace a lane may write throwaway files in. | `/tmp/example-scratch` |
| `standup_enabled` | bool |  | `true` | The daily standup note, its cron and its Inbox row: on unless the pack says false. | `false` |
| `runtime` | str | one of ``, `worktree` |  | Where a ticket's code is checked out: worktree, which absent also means. | `worktree` |
| `slot_browser` | argv |  |  | The command that starts a slot's browser ({slot} and the slot's ports filled in). | `["true"]` |
| `dev_servers` | list |  |  | The commands that start a slot's dev servers, each an argv. | `[["true"]]` |
| `records_dir` | path | security | `"hermes"` (for anything but a text) | The folder inside the workspace the records live in. | `hermes` |
| `board_workdir` | path |  |  | The folder Hermes anchors a worktree card in when the card names none; it starts with {workspace} or {root}. | `{workspace}` |
| `helpers` | path |  |  | The helpers file beside pack.yaml: the dev stack, tunnels and services started from one place. | `helpers.yaml` |
| `board_done_days` | int | 0 to 30 | `2` (also when the key has no value) | How many days a finished ticket's done cards stay on the Board. | `5` |
| `protected_branches` | list | security | `[]` (also when the key has no value) | Branches only the human writes, in every repo that has them. | `["release"]` |
| `demo_login_origins` | list | security |  | The staging.yaml origin names a demo login looks in for the account's password, in order. | `["app"]` |

For each of YOUR threads: is the patch or the reply sufficient? Say so per thread, with a one-clause reason where it is not.\n2. Review ONLY what changed since your review: `git diff {since}..{head}`. New findings only for new code; never re-judge what you already accepted.\n3. Post the table and the new findings as a comment on this card, then write ONE pr-review-submit intent (`cockpit outbox new {ticket} pr-review-submit --repo {repo} --number {number} --sha {head_sha} --event ... --body-file ... --threads-file ...`, with `--review-id <your pending review id>` to append to a pending review).\n"`` (also when empty or 0) | The "Your job" text of a re-review card, for a pack with its own review skills. | `Review {repo}#{number} again from {since} to {head}.` |
| `forge.tagged_comments_only` | bool |  |  | A plain comment asks for work only when it carries a finding tag or a suggestion. | `true` |
